user.title: Sign in to Instant On
user.description: Use the email and password of your HPE Aruba Networking Instant On portal account. Your password is only used to sign in and is not stored; Home Assistant keeps a revocable session token instead.

otp.title: Two-step verification
otp.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for {username}.

data.port_sensors: Create port statistics sensors (speed, PoE, traffic)

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Instant On session for {username} has expired. Enter the password to sign in again (a verification code may follow).

error.invalid_otp: The verification code was not accepted. Wait for a new code and try again.
error.account_locked: The account is locked or not activated. Unlock it in the Instant On portal.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

abort.no_sites: Signed in as {username}, but this account isn't a member of any Instant On site. In the Instant On portal, invite this account to your site (Site settings → Administration), accept the invitation from the email, then try again. Note that Instant On treats name@gmail.com and na.me@gmail.com as different accounts.

data.port_sensors: Create port statistics sensors (speed, PoE, traffic)

data_description.track_clients: Trackers link to existing Home Assistant devices with the same MAC address; trackers for unknown MACs are created disabled.
data_description.scan_interval: How often devices, ports and clients are refreshed. Keep this at 60 seconds or more to avoid being rate limited.

options.watchlist: Only clients on the portal watchlist

lookup_mac.name: Look up MAC address
lookup_mac.description: Finds where a MAC address is connected: access point or switch port, IP address, network and signal.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of a client or Instant On device.
